Leonetti & Associates Llc decreased its stake in Micron Technology (MU) by 51.13% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. The institutional investor held 97,214 shares of the technology company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $5.07 million, down from 198,930 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Leonetti & Associates Llc who had been investing in Micron Technology for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $70.33 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.22% or $0.7499 during the last trading session, reaching $60.6401. About 30.13 million shares traded. Micron Technology, Inc. (NASDAQ:MU) has risen 108.46% since June 12, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 95.89% the S&P500.
Analysts await Micron Technology, Inc. (NASDAQ:MU) to report earnings on June, 20 after the close. They expect $3.10 EPS, up 121.43 % or $1.70 from last year’s $1.4 per share. MU’s profit will be $3.60B for 4.89 P/E if the $3.10 EPS becomes a reality. After $2.80 actual EPS reported by Micron Technology, Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts 10.71 % EPS growth.
